titles.native: オノマトペラップ~なつあそび編~

description:
As the first part of the new project "Okodaoko" by artist Daoko, a MUSIC VIDEO "Onomatopoeia Rap ~Natsu Asobi-hen~", a collaboration with manga artist Keiichi Arawi, who has worked on "Nichijou", "CITY" and "Amamiya-san", is now available!

(Source: YouTube description, translated)
